title: Chapter 502
paragraphs: Chapter 502
Episode 139. Threat (1)
A massive dark cloud, as if flipping over a mountain range, covered the sky of the Sota Desert.
It was the dark cloud formed by Kinzelo's warship, Gruenil.
The dark cloud incessantly spewed out bluish lightning. It looked like a tidal wave spread across the sky.
Inside it, the extinguished Zipple frigates did nothing but break and crash to the ground.
Already, about twenty frigates had been sunk.
With around 150 dragons, more than 1,500 magicians, and the flagship Cozec, most of Drakka's reinforcements were heading anxiously towards Gruenil.
Except for Runcandel, no other force was believed to be able to harm Zipple.
Until the Holy Kingdom incident, Kinzelo had been no more than a third-rate terrorist organization, but now it was contaminating the airspace of the Lutero Magic Federation.
Of course, after the Emperor's Fortress terrorism, it was widely known that Kinzelo was not inferior to the three major forces.
Gruenil seemed to have grown stronger since it first revealed itself in the Emperor's Fortress.
The magical power emitted from the spikes protruding from the hull distorted the surrounding space, and the falling fragments of the frigates made the entire Sota Desert vibrate.
A sandy wind mixed with lightning created fierce whirlwinds everywhere, and the frigates were gradually sucked into them.
'Such a day was bound to come...'
Octavia Zipple.
She stood in the captain's room of the Cozec, observing the situation with an emotionless gaze.
Those who had known Kinzelo's power from the beginning, including Octavia, some of the top magicians, showed no surprise.
Of course, it wasn't that their hearts weren't heavy.
Rather, they were angrier than those who had underestimated Kinzelo.
It wasn't Kinzelo's invasion of the Sota Desert itself, but rather the hidden rationale behind it that had to be uncovered.
'Surely their leader must still be recovering from the Emperor's Fortress terrorism. Yet, they're rampaging like this as if they're going to risk an all-out war.'
Runcandel.
It was because of their existence.
Kinzelo was taking advantage of the fact that as long as Runcandel held on, Zipple could not launch an all-out war, no matter how much they rampaged.
For now.
They couldn't handle both forces at once. No, it might be possible, but after the war, Zipple would suffer devastating damage, close to collapse.
In that case, the world's hegemony wouldn't be taken by those who had lived through the tension of war for the past thousand years, but by someone else who would easily grab it.
Even with hundreds of flying fleets, reproducing the Origin Stone, and developing the immortal biogolem to the brink of completion,

The fact that they couldn't gain an overwhelming advantage in the long, nightmarish tug-of-war, and the reality that their true colors were being exploited by the enemies, stirred an intense hatred that made their skin crawl.
'We must become stronger. We must recover the lost magic and authority of our family sooner, even if it's just a day.'
So, before the time of the Chiron was over, before Kinzelo's leader's body was completed, they wanted to be sure of the fact that they would become the masters of the earth.
Dragons, magicians, and fleets surrounded Gruenil.
Perhaps the term "encirclement" wasn't appropriate. Gruenil didn't show any signs of fleeing even though they saw everyone coming.
Octavia came out of the captain's room and took her place on the front of Cozec. Then she raised her shining staff into the sky.
"Bishkel Evliano!"
Octavia's majestic voice, amplified by magic, echoed through the sky. Bishkel was aboard Gruenil's captain's room.
He didn't lose his unique cold expression even when Octavia appeared.
"I've always wondered why Kinzelo's leader values you so much. Can I see your ability today?"
Bishkel had nothing to say in response.
He didn't have any particular special abilities yet.
He was just meticulous in everything as a deputy leader and always maintained a cool rationality. That was the only virtue.

Compared to the other executives of Kinzelo, who were generally hot-blooded or somewhat ill-tempered, that could be considered an ability. For some reason, he was also easily liked by non-human beings.
In any case, Bishkel's silent and still appearance only intensified Octavia's strange anticipation.
"I hope that seeing your power is worth this humiliation."
Whoosh-!
As magic burst from Octavia's staff, Gruenil's lightning, which had been pounding the area, subsided for a moment.
It was a brief moment, but she had wielded a greater magic power than Gruenil's own.
That power soon turned into a huge net, wrapping around Gruenil and even catching the falling fragments of the frigates.
Beep beep, clang!
A warning sound informing of an impact rang inside Gruenil's ship.
The protective shield, which had even withstood Lon's intangible sword, still had no small cracks, but the ship was tilting due to the net's power.
'Octavia Zipple, indeed the world's second-best.'
A single cold sweat ran down Bishkel's forehead.
Indeed, he wondered how much time the newly recruited person could buy against them this time.
Yawn-!
A woman behind Bishkel yawned as if her mouth would tear.
She was dressed in a fancy dress that did not suit a battle, and a pair of small wings the size of a palm sprouted on her back.
"It seems the time has come! Hey, deputy leader. We only need to fight them until we find those Runcandel bastards, right?"
"…Ainas. It would be better to take a more serious attitude towards the situation."
Ainas Caligo, that was the woman's name.
"Ha! Are you telling the second daughter of the great Caligo family to be serious against inferior humans? Ah, there are dragons too."
Ainas' arrogant and light attitude had been making Bishkel uneasy since before they arrived in the desert.
"Aah, don't look at me like that. I got it, I got it. I just need to do it right, don't I?"
Ainas casually lifted the greatsword lying next to her. Swinging it around while standing looked quite relaxed.
"Can I not only buy time, but also wipe them all out if possible? Hehe."
"This is not the time for jokes."
"Let's see if it's a joke or not. Deputy leader, wait leisurely with a warm cup of tea, I'll slaughter them all before it cools down…"
Watching Ainas ascend to the forefront of Gruenil, Octavia narrowed her eyes.
"A demon… Could it be that you opened the gate? So this was your ability, Bishkel Evliano!"
Octavia's eyes flashed as she began to release her magic again. Ainas scoffed as if she found it amusing and then threw herself into the air towards Octavia.
"Annoying old human lady… Take this!"
However, before reaching Octavia, Ainas was intercepted by a magic barrier cast by other magicians and fell to the ground.
Before hitting the ground, Ainas was covered by the breath of the approaching dragons and magical bombardment, and ended up screaming like this.
"Deputy leader! Help me! Help! Hurry!"
Bishkel could only let out a deep sigh, touching his forehead.
What was even more unfortunate was that Bishkel's despair was not the end.
Swoosh…!
Suddenly, a wave of sword energy rushed in from the ground. Unlike Octavia's net, the sword energy inflicted direct damage on Gruenil's protective shield.
It was Hedo's sword.
Crack!
A crack formed on the lower part of Gruenil's hull, and Bishkel had no way of knowing why such a woman, like a demon, was with him.
'It withstood the Sword Emperor's sword, indeed a sturdy ship.'
Hedo, who had jumped again, scattered his sword energy as he ascended to the front of Cozec.
Octavia's eyes widened in surprise at the sight of his injured figure.

"It seems you've made up your mind very firmly in Kinzelo. I was surprised when the request for support came, but I never expected you to be so badly injured? Moreover, on the way here, I saw that two magical towers were completely destroyed."
Like Bishkel, Hedo also had no answer for Octavia.
So he decided to retaliate instead.
"You should take better care of your subordinates, Captain of the Ghosts."
"Take care of my subordinates?"
"You blindly executed Lady Sandra's orders. Thanks to that, this mess happened."
It was not entirely wrong, but it wasn't exactly the truth either.
However, Octavia had no choice but to decide that now was not the time to argue with Hedo.
"It seems that my subordinates have taken a dislike to you. Let's hear the details later. First, we need to find those who injured you. Who are they, and which way did they flee?"
The sight of Ainas, who was dodging the relentless attacks and panting, came into Hedo's view.
"Uwaaaa, Deputy Leader, what are you doing!"
Demons.
It seemed like a reasonable excuse.
He hoped it would be.
"…It seemed like demons. They escaped towards the Kuta Forest, but the route after that is uncertain."
"Were the Runcandels with them too?"
"The riders, the Black Knight, and the Black Dragon Murakan were together."
He couldn't lie about that. Even if it wasn't perfect, the truth would surely be revealed. If he said he never met Runcandel, it would go beyond a simple deception and become a betrayal.
That would put Sandra in danger.
Octavia's pupils grew even larger at the mention of 'Murakan.'
"The Black Dragon coming means that the 12 Riders are also in the Sota Desert. Now I understand why you struggled."
"We must hurry, or we'll lose them."
Octavia drew a long line in the sky with her staff.
Then, light made of magic moved and continued to form command sentences in rune letters in the sky.
Centered around the Kuta Forest, all the Ghost Riders were to search for the fugitives.
Capture the real Runcandel alive!
As soon as the order was given, ten dragons broke away from the formation and began a full-speed flight towards the Kuta Forest.
Having already experienced the humiliation of losing the real Runcandel several times, the Ghost Riders were determined to capture him this time.
Unfortunately, the direction of the Kuta Forest that Hedo mentioned was the exact opposite of where the real party, including Sandra, had fled.
Hedo just coughed lightly and shot his sword energy at Gruenil again.
